name: Ajahn Sucitto
reason: No published email or contact form (README §18.4): ajahnsucitto.org has no contact page or address (only a Substack newsletter sign-up), and his home monastery Cittaviveka says it does not use email for first contact (phone, post and a guest-stay booking page only; the one email shown is the webmaster's, for site typos).
